rationale: The candidate is legible in all four views as one continuous L/C-shaped mass with a substantial carved court, so it avoids the single-view-only problem and the solids do not read as colliding. The green parcel is respected: the dominant gesture is compact and nested rather than just filling the boundary. The blue access edge is answered by a visible opening/entry void on the corresponding side, which is semantically aligned. Programmatically, the mass can plausibly support a compact gymnasium training hall with entry/service bar and daylight roof logic, but the section remains somewhat generic and the top line reads more like a stepped/terraced extrusion than a decisive long-span hall. That keeps program_fit above threshold but not strong. The strongest positive is the public void/court and the clean anchoring of the mass around it; the main weakness is that the roof/section does not yet clearly express span or daylight as a gym-specific invariant.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Single low pavilion wrapped around a clear court/void; strong precedent for an accessible public threshold and continuous horizontal massing.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More generic campus bar than clear-span hall; facade/screen language is not the point here.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Low, elongated sports volume with a subtle entry recess and side attachment; useful for subordinate service bar logic.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate is much smaller and more compact; do not over-import the bridge-heavy composition.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced sports massing with pronounced roof span and open concourse/plaza edge; strong for sectionally expressive athletic programs.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Primary typology is not clearly sports, so treat as a massing precedent only.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Long horizontal bar with a deep canopy and recessed ground level; good for public edge and hierarchy between host volume and support element.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This is more generic low-rise building language and lacks the sports-specific long-span clarity.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Simple boxy mass with a set-back/recessed ground plane; useful as a restraint reference for the dominant volume.

warnings: The form is acceptable as a compact gymnasium, but the section still needs a stronger long-span or daylight cue to read more convincingly as athletic program.
If iterated, preserve the dominant carved court and avoid fragmenting the mass into separate bars.
